content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR CRRI recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview. The interview dates are 15th September 2026 for Young Professional-I and 16th September 2026 for Field Operator. Candidates should attend the interview on these dates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by ICAR CRRI?
faq.answer: ICAR-Central Rice Research Institute has announced a total of 2 vacancies for the posts of Young Professional-I (YP-I) and Field Operator (FO).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional-I post?
faq.answer: For the Young Professional-I (YP-I) post, candidates must possess a B.Sc. (Hons.) degree in Agriculture, Botany, Biotechnology, Environmental Science, Microbiology, or Molecular Biology.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligibility criteria for the Field Operator post?
faq.answer: The Field Operator (FO) post requires Matriculation with +2 Vocational in an agricultural-related subject, or a Diploma in an agricultural-related subject, or two years of working experience in an agriculture-related field.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for ICAR CRRI recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-I and Field Operator posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly salary for Young Professional-I is ₹ 30,000/-, and for Field Operator, it is ₹ 18,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for the ICAR CRRI recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify a minimum or maximum age limit. However, age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India norms for SC, ST, and OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the ICAR CRRI recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. Candidates need to attend the interview at the specified venue on the given dates with all required documents.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs. This includes ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the ICAR CRRI located?
faq.answer: ICAR-Central Rice Research Institute is located in Cuttack, Odisha, with the pincode 753006.
